vendors.name: Circle (USDC)
vendors.description: Send USDC on Base or Solana. Recipient cashes out via local Circle partner or exchange.
vendors.notes: USDC assumed 1:1 USD parity. Recipient needs exchange or offramp partner in destination country.

vendors.name: dLocal
vendors.description: Payments infrastructure specialist for emerging markets. Accepts USD/USDC, pays out in local currency to local banks.
vendors.notes: Strong local banking relationships in LatAm and Africa. Handles local compliance.
vendors.best_for: LatAm and Africa corridors, regulated flows, large B2B

vendors.name: Ebanx
vendors.description: LatAm payment specialist. Deep local rails in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia.
vendors.settlement_time: Same day via PIX/SPEI, 1-2 days others
vendors.notes: Best-in-class for Brazil PIX and Mexico SPEI. Local entity required for some products.
vendors.best_for: Brazil and Mexico specifically, instant local rails

vendors.name: Bitso Business
vendors.description: Crypto-native PSP strong in Mexico and LatAm. Accept USDC, deliver MXN/BRL to local bank accounts.
vendors.notes: Regulated in Mexico. Strong FX desk for MXN. Ideal bridge for stablecoin-to-local-fiat.
vendors.best_for: Mexico corridor, USDC to MXN, speed-sensitive

vendors.name: Stellar / MoneyGram
vendors.description: MoneyGram uses Stellar network for USDC settlement with cash pickup globally.
vendors.notes: Best for unbanked recipients needing cash. MoneyGram retail network in 200+ countries.
vendors.best_for: Unbanked recipients, cash pickup, consumer remittance

vendors.name: Stripe (with Bridge)
vendors.description: Stripe payment infrastructure with Bridge stablecoin orchestration layer for cross-border.
vendors.notes: Best developer experience. Less coverage in emerging markets. Strong for developed market corridors.
vendors.best_for: US-Europe, US-UK, strong compliance posture, developer-friendly

vendors.name: Ripple / ODL
vendors.description: On-Demand Liquidity using XRP as bridge asset. Instant cross-border settlement for financial institutions.
vendors.notes: Requires institutional account. Not available retail. Strong for treasury and B2B flows.
vendors.best_for: Large B2B, institutional, treasury operations, no pre-funding

vendors.name: SWIFT GPI
vendors.description: Traditional SWIFT wire with GPI tracking. Universal coverage but slower and expensive.
vendors.notes: Fixed wire fees $15-45 plus correspondent bank charges. Float cost on large amounts significant.
vendors.best_for: Universal coverage, compliance-heavy institutions, very large amounts where pct fee matters less
